title: fix(app-shell): name Studio's group-title, Description, Help text and nav-item inputs

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbXRpscK3dszbSuQtCmGe4R8)_

Fixes #26732

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Studio 里五个输入框以前读屏软件读不出名字:表单设计器里分组标题的行内输入框、字段属性面板的「描述」和「帮助文本」、界面导航项属性面板的「链接到对象」下拉和「标签」输入框。现在每个都有可读的名字,点击标签也会聚焦到对应输入框。外观和保存内容都不变。
- **为什么改**:QA 读无障碍树时发现这几处是无名编辑框(studio-qa-2026-10-27,U7),自动化无障碍检查也会报错。
- **风险与回滚**:很低。只加了 `id`/`htmlFor` 关联和一个 `aria-label`,没有新文案键,不动元数据和 spec。一个旧测试钉住了「对象下拉没有名字」,本 PR 把它改为钉住新名字。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 里 `StudioNavItemInspector` 的两处 `htmlFor`;`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` 的 `TextareaField`;`StudioDesignSurface.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx` 改掉的那条断言。
- **两分钟验证**:在 Studio 打开一个应用的导航项,点「链接到对象」这几个字,预期下拉获得焦点;或在浏览器无障碍面板里看到该下拉名为 "Link to object"。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Form designer group title** (`ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`): a declared group's inline title input element had no label, `aria-label` or `id`. No visible label sits beside it, so it takes `aria-label` from the label the group inspector already gives the same value, `engine.studio.designer.group.nameLabel` ("Group name" / 「分组名称」). No new key.
- **Field inspector Description and Help text** (`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`): the file-local `TextareaField` drew its `Label` beside the textarea element without closing the pair. It now mints a per-instance `React.useId()` and sets `htmlFor` ⇄ `id`, the way `_shared.tsx`'s form atoms (`InspectorTextField`, `InspectorNumberField`) close theirs. Every `TextareaField` in the inspector gets its name from this one change.
- **Interfaces nav-item inspector** (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `StudioNavItemInspector` only): the *Link to object* label and the *Label* label were drawn above their controls without `htmlFor`. Both now close the pair with a `useId()`, as the same inspector's target, URL, *Open in* and icon fields already did. The object picker is the shared `StudioPicker`, which already forwards `id` to its Radix trigger, so no component changed; its header comment now says the object picker is named like the others.

## Tests

- `ObjectFieldInspector.textareaNames-26732.test.tsx`: Description and Help text found by `getByRole('textbox', { name })` and `getByLabelText` in en; a zh case awaits `loadStudioCatalogue('zh')` at module scope (the #26800 pattern) and finds both by 「描述」 / 「帮助文本」.
- `ObjectFormDesigner.groupTitleName-26732.test.tsx`: the group-title input found by `getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Group name' })`, holding the group's label.
- `StudioDesignSurface.navItemInspectorNames-26732.test.tsx`: the object picker found by `getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Link to object' })` (and it is the `nav-link-object` trigger), the Label input by `getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Label' })`.
- `StudioDesignSurface.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx`: its pin "the object picker had none" now reads the object picker's name as `Link to object`.
- Ablation (one-off, not kept), each with the fix committed, through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, restored blob equal to HEAD each time): dropping the group input's `aria-label` reds its test (1 failed of 1); dropping `htmlFor={id}` from `TextareaField` reds both textarea cases (2 failed of 2); dropping the object picker's `id` reds the nav test, and so does dropping the Label input's `id` (1 failed of 1 each). `git diff HEAD` empty after all four.

## Acceptance notes

- **Sweep of the three files for the same hole.** `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx` has no other unnamed input (its icon buttons all carry `aria-label`). In `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`, every control other than `TextareaField` is a `_shared.tsx` atom that already closes its pair, an `InspectorComboField` with a label or `ariaLabel`, or a checkbox inside its label element; the picklist option rows' value and label inputs are named by their placeholders ("Value", "Label") and the color swatch by its `title`, so they are not unnamed and are left as they are. In the nav-item inspector, the type radios sit inside their labels and the remaining fields were already tied.
- **A pinned behaviour is reversed on purpose.** `StudioDesignSurface.sharedSelect-11865` pinned that the object picker kept the native control's lack of a name; this card asks for that name, so the pin now reads it.
